description: This file defines an Android Activity that demonstrates hiding and showing fragments with animated transitions, along with two nested fragment classes that demonstrate saving state within their views.

classes.name: FragmentHideShow
classes.description: Main activity demonstrating fragment hide/show with buttons and animations.

classes.name: FragmentHideShow.FirstFragment
classes.description: A fragment that displays a text view with saved and restored text state.

classes.name: FragmentHideShow.SecondFragment
classes.description: A fragment that displays a text view with save-enabled state.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Sets up the activity, retrieves fragments, and attaches hide/show listeners to buttons.

methods.name: addShowHideListener
methods.description: Attaches a click listener to toggle visibility of a fragment with animation.

methods.name: FirstFragment.onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the view for the first fragment and restores saved text state.

methods.name: FirstFragment.onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves the current text in the TextView to state bundle.

methods.name: SecondFragment.onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the view for the second fragment and enables save on its TextView.
